title: Coverage of each Article 10 obligation
question: For every obligation, how many standard requirements satisfy it completely or partially?

title: Gaps: obligations no requirement addresses
question: Which obligations are not satisfied, even partially, by any requirement of the standard?

title: Partial alignments and what is missing
question: Where a requirement only partially satisfies an obligation, what is the documented gap?

title: Most load-bearing requirements
question: Which standard clauses support the largest number of distinct obligations?
sparql:
PREFIX aidgo: <https://w3id.org/aidgo#>
PREFIX tair: <https://w3id.org/tair#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?clause (COUNT(DISTINCT ?o) AS ?obligations)
WHERE {
  ?a aidgo:legalRequirement ?o ; aidgo:technicalRequirement ?r ; aidgo:alignmentType ?t .
  FILTER(?t IN (aidgo:CompletelySatisfies, aidgo:PartiallySatisfies))
  { ?r dct:source ?clause } 
}
GROUP BY ?clause
ORDER BY DESC(?obligations) ?clause
LIMIT 10

title: Provenance of every assertion for one obligation
question: Who asserted each alignment for Art. 10(2)(f), by which activity, and on what basis?

title: Obligation elements a requirement must guarantee
question: Into which elements is each obligation decomposed, and which is the core element?
sparql:
PREFIX aidgo: <https://w3id.org/aidgo#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
SELECT ?article ?role ?core ?element
WHERE {
  ?o aidgo:articleReference ?article ; aidgo:hasElement ?e .
  ?e aidgo:elementRole ?role ; aidgo:isCoreElement ?core ; skos:definition ?element .
}
ORDER BY ?article DESC(?core) ?role
